details: President Trump signed an Executive Order on May 19, 2026, directing federal financial regulators to reassess and update rules that hinder the integration of digital assets into traditional financial services. This initiative aims to reduce costs, foster competition, and encourage collaboration between traditional finance and the crypto sector. Key actions include the repeal of SEC Staff Accounting Bulletin 121, which previously made crypto custody expensive for banks.
title: White House Executive Order Aims to Boost Crypto Integration

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has delayed its "innovation exemption" plan for tokenized stocks, pushing back the release of a framework that would have allowed digital tokens linked to publicly traded shares to trade on decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms. The delay is attributed to concerns raised by traditional stock exchanges and other market participants regarding potential dilution of investor protections and market distortion.
title: SEC Delays Plan for Tokenized Stock Exemptions

details: The total crypto market cap declined by 2.4-2.6% on May 23, with Bitcoin falling below $75,000 from $77,500. This downturn is influenced by a broader risk-off sentiment and ongoing geopolitical uncertainty. Ethereum, Solana, and other altcoins also experienced price drops, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index currently stands at 28, indicating "Fear." Despite the general market correction, some altcoins like SOL and BNB showed rotational strength, but overall sentiment remains cautious.
title: Crypto Market Experiences Price Correction Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty

details: A Wall Street Journal report on May 22 alleged that approximately $850 million moved through Binance via a covert Iranian payments network, with activity continuing into late 2025. Binance CEO Richard Teng publicly rejected these allegations, but the story introduces regulatory and reputational risk for the exchange. Separately, Polymarket reported a suspected $520,000 exploit on Polygon, linked to a private key compromise in internal operations, highlighting ongoing DeFi infrastructure risks.
title: Binance Faces Iran Allegations; Polymarket Suffers Exploit

details: LiquidNFTs.finance officially relaunched on Bitcoin Pizza Day (May 22, 2026), introducing an innovative approach to NFT trading and liquidity. The platform aims to transform NFTs from static digital collectibles into dynamic financial instruments by directly linking liquidity to each NFT, enabling holders to redeem value without solely relying on secondary market buyers.
title: Liquid NFTs Relaunches with Enhanced Liquidity Model

details: PopDEX, a decentralized perpetual exchange (perp DEX), successfully closed a $30 million seed funding round on May 22, led by Foresight Ventures. This significant investment signals renewed venture capital interest and confidence in the growth and potential comeback of the perpetual decentralized exchange sector within the DeFi space.
title: PopDEX Secures $30 Million Seed Round for Perp DEXs

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR), a company that has strategically positioned itself as the world's largest Ethereum treasury holder, has been included on the preliminary additions list for the 2026 Russell 3000 Index. The list, published on May 22-23, could lead to significant institutional capital inflow for BMNR if confirmed in June, as index funds and ETFs would be compelled to purchase its shares.
title: Bitmine Added to Russell 3000 Index Preliminary List
